status: First Volo research-informed design, not a validated universal sequence
scope: Learn card grouping; existing Flight/game evidence collections retain membership and IDs

basis.limit: Historical school-English corpus; not a grade-specific root list

basis.source: White et al. Table 3; Park et al. 2020; AdLit/TEA conceptual instruction
basis.use: Group related meanings, contrast alternatives, explain connections
basis.limit: Exact category names and memberships are First Volo design choices; thematic root groups are not single morphological families

basis.source: Brimo & Henbest 2020; reviewed Mendes & Kirby 2024 methods
basis.use: Familiar transparent examples before more changes; guided practice then untaught words
basis.limit: No optimal order proven; adapt based on explanations, support and fresh-word use

basis.source: CCSS and Massachusetts 2017 ELA frameworks; Green & Wolter 2025
basis.limit: Standards do not mandate our individual morpheme lists; Flight is separate from school grade

basis.use: Approximate example-word difficulty when a badge is verified
basis.limit: No badge is missing classification, not level zero. Official grade-band descriptions differ; do not assign exact grade from WVI alone.

instructional_next_step: Meet one part, inspect examples, sort/explain, then apply to an untaught word in context; revisit with support when meaning cannot be explained independently

practitioner_sources.role: Modeled analysis, repeated practice, content-area application
Concept relationships, examples/nonexamples, word-part plus context
Sentence meaning, content vocabulary, interdisciplinary teaching; definitions/examples critically reviewed
Expert discussion of frequency lists alongside family investigations, not a trial

groups.title: Not, opposite, or undo
groups.purpose: Compare negative meanings with undoing an action. Explain which meaning fits each word.

groups.title: Again, before, or back
groups.purpose: Notice how a prefix changes when an action happens or its direction. Check the whole word in context.

groups.title: Wrongly or badly
groups.purpose: Explain how mis- changes the meaning of a familiar base.

groups.title: Place, direction, and degree
groups.purpose: Compare where something is, where it moves, or how much. Related ideas can have different meanings.

groups.title: Number, time, and comparison
groups.purpose: Explain what the part changes: amount, tense, an ongoing action, or comparison.

groups.title: Together or against
groups.purpose: Contrast joining with opposing. Explain the exact relationship in each whole word.

groups.title: Causing a change
groups.purpose: Explain what the base means and what changes when en- or em- is added.

groups.title: People and what they do
groups.purpose: Compare endings that name a person or agent. Explain the base and what the person does.

groups.title: Qualities and ways of doing
groups.purpose: Compare qualities, ability, and manner. Check whether the whole word describes a thing or how an action happens.

groups.title: Actions, states, and new word forms
groups.purpose: Compare each base with its new form. Explain both the meaning and the word’s job in a sentence.

groups.title: Moving, carrying, and sending
groups.purpose: Explore one root family at a time, then compare these movement ideas. Related meanings do not make these the same root.

groups.title: Communicating and noticing
groups.purpose: Explore separate families about saying, writing, hearing, and seeing. Explain the precise connection in each word.

groups.title: Investigating the world
groups.purpose: Explore separate families used in content words. Connect each word to its own root’s meaning and check the whole-word definition.
